versions.changelog:
- Bumped version to 1.0.1
- Removed the author and agent_created fields from SKILL.md metadata
- No changes to content or usage instructions

Initial public release of dotnet-dump-perf-analyzer.

- Provides end-to-end .NET application performance diagnostics using the dotnet diagnostic toolchain (dotnet-dump, dotnet-counters, dotnet-trace, etc.).
- Diagnoses CPU hotspots, GC pressure, managed memory leaks, thread pool exhaustion, and system resource contention.
- Supports ASP.NET Core, ASP.NET on IIS, WPF, and console apps across Windows, Linux, and macOS.
- Generates interactive HTML reports for diagnostics.
- Includes optional Windows system metrics collection (perfmon, relog) and industry benchmark comparisons (PAL thresholds).
